# Task 2 - Exploratory Data Analysis

## Objective
Perform Exploratory Data Analysis on the cleaned car dataset.

## Tools Used
- Python
- Pandas
- Matplotlib
- Seaborn
- Jupyter Notebook

## Analysis Performed
- Dataset Summary
- Descriptive Statistics
- Correlation Analysis
- Histograms
- Heatmap
- Boxplot
- Scatter Plot
- Count Plots

## Key Insights
- Newer cars have higher selling prices.
- Higher mileage reduces selling price.
- Petrol vehicles dominate the dataset.
- SUVs are the most common body type.
- Selling price contains some outliers.

## Conclusion
EDA helped identify relationships, trends, and patterns that can support future predictive modeling.
